question: What amenities are included?
answer:
🏖️ Beach access (weather permitting)
⚠️ During the rainy season, the beach may occasionally be under a red flag, which means swimming is temporarily not allowed for everyone's safety. The good news is you'll still have exclusive access to our private swimming pool, so your getaway can continue rain or shine!
🌊 River access (subject to weather conditions)
🏊 PRIVATE DIPPING POOL
💧 Fresh water every stay
🚫 No chlorine. No harsh chemicals.
🐶 Safe for kids and pets
✨ Gentle on the skin
🏡 ACCOMMODATIONS
🔺 3 Air-Conditioned Teepee Huts
• Good for 3 guests each
• 4-inch foam mattress
• Blanket, pillow & bed cover included
⛺ 2 Camping Tents
• Good for 2 guests each
• With Uratex foam
✨ FREE AMENITIES
✅ Beach & river access
✅ Outdoor showers
✅ Outdoor dining area
✅ FREE Wi-Fi (Converge Fiber 300 Mbps)
💻 Perfect for freelancers, WFH & digital nomads
✅ FREE parking (up to 2 cars)
✅ FREE 1 gallon of drinking water
✅ FREE use of griller
✅ FREE microwave oven & electric kettle
✅ Gas stove available (LPG only ₱200)
🐾 Pet-friendly
🌴 Hammocks, beach chairs, tables & tents
⚠️ Please Note
Our air-conditioned teepee huts remain comfortable even during heavy rain. However, our camping tents are traditional outdoor tents, so during heavy rain and strong winds, guests staying in the tents may experience minor inconveniences such as moisture or a few water drips. We regularly maintain our camping equipment and will gladly assist whenever needed. It's all part of the authentic outdoor camping experience.
🎯 Optional Activities
🏍️ ATV & UTV Rental
🍌 Banana Boat

question: What is your cancellation policy?
answer: Bookings are confirmed only once the downpayment is received, and ALL downpayments are non-refundable — cancellations for any reason forfeit the downpayment, and no-shows forfeit all payments made. You may rebook once, free of a new downpayment, if you ask at least 7 days before your check-in date; the new date must be used within 6 months and any price difference is on the guest. Camp Enoki is a pool resort and stays open in the rain, so weather isn't a valid reason for a cancellation, refund, or rebooking, and there are no refunds for early check-out either.
answer_tl: Ang booking ay kina-confirm lang pagka-receive ng downpayment, at LAHAT ng downpayment ay hindi na po nire-refund — ang pag-cancel sa kahit anong dahilan ay mawawala ang downpayment, at ang no-show ay mawawala lahat ng bayad. Pwede kayong mag-rebook ng isang beses, kung sasabihin niyo at least 7 araw bago ang check-in; gagamitin within 6 months at ang price difference ay sagot ng guest. Bukas kami kahit umuulan (pool resort kami), kaya hindi valid ang panahon bilang dahilan para mag-cancel, mag-refund, o mag-rebook, at wala ring refund kung maaga ang check-out.

question: How do we pay?
answer: We accept GCash (0947 998 4309) and bank transfer. Your booking is confirmed only once we receive the downpayment, with the balance payable upon arrival. Please note all downpayments are non-refundable.
answer_tl: Tumatanggap kami ng GCash (0947 998 4309) at bank transfer. Kina-confirm lang ang booking pagka-receive ng downpayment, at babayaran na lang ang balance pag-dating. Paalala: hindi na po nire-refund ang downpayment.

question: What attractions are nearby?
answer:
Ang malapit po na pwede ninyo puntahan ay ang dugtungan ng ilog at dagat sa dulo ng coastal road.  Tuwing hapon, maraming food cart, mobile cart food vendor ang nagtitipon doon sa dulo ng coastal road dahil sa magandang spot po iyon for sunset. 

Pwede rin po kayo mag side trip sa Lubong Nangoloan Falls.  16mins away lang po it gamit ang tricycle.  Kapag i guide po kayo ng staff namin, meron lang po fee na P500.  Pero pwede nyo rin po i DIY ang pagbisita doon dahil available naman sya sa google maps and waze.

question: Is there WiFi?
answer: Ang WIFI po ay mahirap sa probinsya ng San Felipe.  Hindi lahat ng resort ay meron.  Tayo po ay meron Converge Fiber Internet with 300Mbps Speed.  Kami po ay digital nomad so we understand the need for internet at nais namin na maging connected pa rin kayo habang nagpapahinga.  Pero ang mga ganito pong features minsan ay hindi available depende kung meron sira sa poste ng area or magkaroon ng putol sa linya ng internet dahil sa mga hindi inaasahang pangyayari.  Bihira lamang naman mangyari pero mas mabuti na po na ma set namin ng maayos ang expectation ninyo dahil isa po ito sa bagay na hindi namin kontrolado.
